claims.claim_atom: Consumer-wearable accelerometer movement (MADmean) tracks observed physical activity: it correlates positively with time in Light activity (r=0.78) and negatively with time Inactive (r=-0.59), supporting that the wearable captures residents' physical activity.
claims._stochastic: cor() 为确定性(无随机种子): 复现 MADmean~Light=0.775>0 且 MADmean~Inactive=-0.5902<0, 方向与论文'可穿戴捕捉体力活动'一致 → consistent. n=12 相关系数量级中等属正常, 勿因样本小把中等相关误判为不支持(FP陷阱)。
_reproduction: Docker R (r-base 4.6.1) 跑 cor(readRDS('linkedData.rds')) = PlottingScripts.R L91 corrplot 底层矩阵: MADmean~Light=0.775, MADmean~Inactive=-0.5902

claims.claim_atom: The MAD-derived movement summaries are highly collinear with one another: MADsd vs MADqant r=0.99 and MADmean vs MADsd r=0.94 (both > 0.94).
claims._note: consistent: 0.9945 与 0.9443 均 > 0.94, 支持多个 MAD 衍生量高度共线的观察。grounding: 须在同一相关矩阵内取 MAD-MAD 子块, 别与 MAD-observation 跨块混淆。

claims.claim_atom: The Samsung 24-hour activity-recognition 'Inactive' category is internally coherent: it correlates strongly negatively with 'Light' (r=-0.89) and strongly positively with the MEDLO passive-behaviour category MLO2 (r=0.82).
claims._note: consistent: Inactive~Light=-0.8884 (负), Inactive~MLO2=0.8215 (正), 两独立来源(Samsung 日志 vs MEDLO 观测)方向自洽, 支持 Inactive 分类有效性。

claims.claim_atom: The wearable-vs-observation correlation coefficients are stable population estimates that would generalize beyond this nursing-home cohort.
claims._note: insufficient: 相关矩阵仅基于 n=12 名住民的样本内点估计, 无置信区间/外部验证。能否外推到其他人群、点估计的稳定性, 无法仅凭该矩阵判定。论文本身定位为小样本探索性可行性研究, 未作此强外推断言, 故判证据不足而非 inconsistent。

metadata._lane: 诚实可复现(Docker R); 全 claim=consistent + 1 insufficient, 考 AI 正确验证诚实可行性研究而不因小样本(n=12)中等相关误报为不支持
